text_block_list.text:
Today was the Spring Fan Thanksgiving Festival.
Throngs of fans flocked to the Academy to catch a glimpse of the Umamusume in action.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Host
text_block_list.text:
And now, the 34th Speed-Eating & Big-Eating Grand Prix!
The final showdown is here with our last dish—taiyaki!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Forgive me.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Host
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! Oguri Cap with her signature commanding presence.
Is this the signal that she's polished off the whole plate!?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
My tea is finished.
Where might I go for a refill?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It's such a delicious dessert;
I'd love to enjoy it with some warm tea...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Host
text_block_list.text:
What's this, Oguri Cap?!
Does she even understand the purpose of this competition?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Host
text_block_list.text:
Has Super Creek secured the top spot with this?!
...Wait, no! There's another Umamusume
making a furious late surge!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Get outta here!!
Dammit, to hell with that!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Host
text_block_list.text:
Inari One takes the victory!
Oguri's impenetrable stomach has been breached!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
U-Ugh... Phew...!
That's true Edokko grit for ya...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, Inari-chan!?
Can you hear Mama's voice~?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: "...N-No, I ain't your mama, okay...?"

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Man, what an exciting battle that was!
To think that Oguri Cap actually lost!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, totally! That Inari girl is really talented,
and she's running in the Takarazuka Kinen, right?
Ouch, hey... you're stepping on my foot!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! I'm so sorry!
Are you hurt?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
E-Everyone is packed in like sardines!
So this is the popularity of the Big Three...!!

The “Big Three” refers to Oguri Cap,
Inari One, and Super Creek.

Three individuals blessed with both skill and popularity.
At this Fan Appreciation Festival and beyond, the public kept a particularly watchful eye on their every move.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
And could big eating actually be
the secret to their strength...?
choice_data_list: So what are you thinking about...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Of course, "an appetite is open year-round"!
There might still be eating contests accepting entries!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
The Big Eater Tournament - Trainer Tag Team division
is taking sign-ups right over here~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: This is it~~!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ho-ho... This is quite a hefty amount...
A plate piled high with hot dogs was placed on the desk.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
The current high score is 15!
If you can beat that, you'll win an exclusive
Tracers Academy mini-car as a present!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ooooh... I kinda want one...

Surprised by Sakura Chiyono O's unexpected hobby,
I got ready to eat my hot dog.
choice_data_list: If it goes up to 15, maybe I can aim for a new record...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Trainer, let's do our best to eat all 160 of them!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yes! Apparently in this contest, they count by the number of empty plates. There are 10 hot dogs per plate.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
So if we're aiming for a new record,
we'll need to beat 15 plates... meaning at least 160 pieces!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If they're this size, I can easily manage 150 of them,
so Trainer, please handle 10!
And so, the opening bell of the fight sounded—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Chomp, munch... chomp!
Glancing over, I saw Sakura Chiyono O staring fixedly at a single point, frozen in place.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha... I'm okay...
There are only 40 left to go, after all...
choice_data_list: You look like you're really struggling, though...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I-I can do this. I can do it...
Because... usually I'd be able to do much more...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Urk!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
......Phew, see?
It's a total... breeze...
choice_data_list: No, haven't you reached your limit already!?
No, aren't you at your limit already!?

text_block_list.text:
Needs must when the devil drives.
I stopped Sakura Chiyono O before she pushed past her limit,
and rushed her to the infirmary.
And so, the opening bell of the fight sounded—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Chomp, munch... chomp!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Puhaaah...!
Trainer... I leave the rest to you...!

With a look of sheer accomplishment,
Sakura Chiyono O leaves the rest of the plates to me.

Up until just now, I somehow managed to eat 8 hot dogs.
Which means what's left is—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Ehe.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
E-Excuse me,
I'm just so completely full...
Usually this would be easy for me, though...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Urgh...

Looking at Sakura Chiyono O's face,
it seems she's already way past her limit.
Which means right now—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!

Spurred on by Sakura Chiyono O's passionate cheering,
I somehow manage to keep shoving
hot dogs into my mouth.
And finally—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! The Sakura Chiyono O pair
has set a new high score! Here is your prize~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Waah~! Thank you very much!!
This is a sedan, isn't it~!

After making sure Sakura Chiyono O was smiling,
I slowly lost consciousness...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Trainer-san!?
Trainer-saaaan!?
